pointcast.label: PointCast blockchain
pointcast.note: PointCast has a local development prototype with a verified replay of its recorded 422-block snapshot. No public node is advertised; a public network and mint adapter are not configured for this collection. The existing PointCast marketplace runs on Tezos. First Mints remains a design preview.

disclosure: Preview only. Planned artwork price: 1 tez. Purchase, minting and listing are unavailable. Network fees are additional and currently unknown; the signing wallet must show its estimate. No tokens, stock, ownership or completed sales are asserted.
